pr6.rule: PR #49 synchronized the PR #6 audio foundation with current main; runtime event IDs and the payload pin were revalidated by Audio Validation #182 before merge. Any future payload change must be re-pinned and physically re-verified.

mappings.derivationIntent: If human-approved, extract genuinely different temporal wind sections/levels as separate derivatives; preserve one immutable original.
guardrails: Do not replace the current first-playable wind source merely because this original is acquired.
Compare contamination, island fit, variation value and Quest speech masking before source selection.
Different runtime variations must reflect different physical/time behaviour, not gain-only copies.

mappings.derivationIntent: If human-approved, identify distinct intensity regions before deciding whether the source can legitimately feed one or both rain states.
guardrails: Measured true peak reaches about +0.1 dBFS; attenuate before derived processing.
Do not derive Light and Heavy by level/EQ only if the underlying rain behaviour is not meaningfully different.
Inspect the 202.877 s peak region before source approval.

mappings.derivationIntent: If human-approved, use only if distinct fire-state material can be identified; otherwise target one fire state rather than manufacturing a second near-duplicate.
guardrails: The current first-playable Idle/Low pair is already flagged for extreme objective similarity and needs A/B review.
Do not solve that issue by deriving two gain/EQ variants from this single 29.26 s source.
Source is 44.1 kHz; any accepted derivative must use quality 48 kHz resampling and receive another listening pass.

notYetAcquiredExtensions.rule: Acquire and listen before any mapping is promoted beyond candidate intent.
Archive must be acquired and individual files inspected/licensed/listened before use.
Archive must be acquired and individual files inspected/licensed/listened before use.

hardRules: Candidate target mapping is not source approval.
No candidate mapping changes the current first-playable artifact pin.
A source-selected decision requires human listening evidence tied to the exact source SHA-256.
Derived files require new hashes and repeat listening QA.
Final Unity spatialization, mix and Quest acceptance remain Claude-owned physical gates.
